title: Glowing piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- piano body -->
  <rect x='10' y='45' width='80' height='38' rx='4' fill='#1a2a5a'/>
  <!-- body lighter edge -->
  <rect x='12' y='47' width='76' height='10' rx='3' fill='#2d4a8a'/>
  <!-- keyboard white background -->
  <rect x='14' y='56' width='72' height='22' rx='2' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- white keys -->
  <rect x='15' y='57' width='7' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='23' y='57' width='7' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='31' y='57' width='7' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='39' y='57' width='7' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='47' y='57' width='7' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='55' y='57' width='7' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='63' y='57' width='7' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='71' y='57' width='7' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <rect x='79' y='57' width='6' height='20' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- white key shading edges -->
  <rect x='22' y='57' width='1' height='20' fill='#cfcfcf'/>
  <rect x='30' y='57' width='1' height='20' fill='#cfcfcf'/>
  <rect x='38' y='57' width='1' height='20' fill='#cfcfcf'/>
  <rect x='46' y='57' width='1' height='20' fill='#cfcfcf'/>
  <rect x='54' y='57' width='1' height='20' fill='#cfcfcf'/>
  <rect x='62' y='57' width='1' height='20' fill='#cfcfcf'/>
  <rect x='70' y='57' width='1' height='20' fill='#cfcfcf'/>
  <rect x='78' y='57' width='1' height='20' fill='#cfcfcf'/>
  <!-- black keys (deep lit purple-blue) -->
  <rect x='19' y='57' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <rect x='27' y='57' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <rect x='43' y='57' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <rect x='51' y='57' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <rect x='59' y='57' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <rect x='75' y='57' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <!-- glowing music notes -->
  <g fill='#7cf0ff'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='30' r='4'/>
    <rect x='33' y='18' width='2' height='13' fill='#7cf0ff'/>
    <rect x='33' y='18' width='8' height='2' fill='#7cf0ff'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='22' r='3.5'/>
    <rect x='54' y='11' width='2' height='12' fill='#7cf0ff'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='32' r='4'/>
    <rect x='73' y='20' width='2' height='13' fill='#7cf0ff'/>
    <rect x='73' y='20' width='8' height='2' fill='#7cf0ff'/>
  </g>
  <!-- glow rays -->
  <g stroke='#7cf0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'>
    <line x1='38' y1='32' x2='38' y2='27'/>
    <line x1='62' y1='26' x2='62' y2='21'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='38' x2='50' y2='35'/>
  </g>
  <!-- little glow sparkles -->
  <g fill='#aaf7ff'>
    <circle cx='22' cy='26' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='80' cy='30' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='44' cy='20' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
